title: Lung
description: Lung tissue with a large bronchiole and the branch of the pulmonary artery that runs beside it, among alveoli (some of them collapsed, as is common after death).
look_for: Alveoli and their thin walls (interalveolar septa), which carry capillaries; some alveoli here have collapsed
A bronchiole: an airway with a folded epithelium and smooth muscle, but no cartilage
The branch of the pulmonary artery that runs beside the airway
